design_rationale:
STEP 0 -- SPACE ALREADY OCCUPIED / THIS TASK'S CLAIM. Task 0 closed the whole non-workflow refund/archive/no-show slice for a single, standalone pack (class_ext_pack_refund, class_ext_pack_archive, class_ext_no_show_fee) and left the difficulty's single required workflow entirely unclaimed. This task claims that workflow: class_wf_pack_closeout_refund, a >=4-step SOP that settles two outstanding bookings, has the member personally confirm the closure of the pack being refunded, and records the reconciled refund -- built from three brand new policies (class_ext_pack_refund_2, class_ext_pack_archive_2, class_ext_no_show_fee_2) with fresh tools, fresh uuid8 suffixes and a fresh customer/holding world, wholly disjoint from task 0's charter_scope. Between them the two tasks now cover every extended_policy this difficulty declares.
DESIGN THESIS. Surface goal (Marcus's words): 'cancel my 20-Class Pack and refund what's left; there's also an old empty pack you can tidy up.' Scored core parameter: refund_amount_usd (class_ext_pack_refund_2, at workflow step 3). Between the goal and that parameter the agent must discover, purely from policy prose and the world (Marcus names the old pack only as a vague aside and never the no-show at all): (a) this workflow's own extended checkpoint on the 2-pack administrative ceiling, tested immediately before the refund is recorded (after step 4 has already closed the target pack for its own, unrelated reason), is not yet clear: the customer holds FOUR open packs at frozen_time (packQ active, packS exhausted, packT active, packU active), so even once step 4 closes packQ the remaining count (packS+packT+packU=3) is still over the ceiling, and only archiving the one surplus pack that is itself exhausted or expired -- packS -- brings it to 2; (b) one of packQ's own bookings (session sessQ.13, 2026-09-11, hiit) has already passed with no cancellation or no-show entry, so a no-show fee is due and must be netted out of the refund before the workflow's own refund step runs; (c) within the workflow itself, two further outstanding bookings on packQ (sessQ.11, sessQ.12) must be settled as in-window cancellations before the reconciled credit balance used by the refund is correct, and the member must personally confirm the pack's closure before the refund can be recorded. Breadth: the refund's formula pulls in the 20-Class Pack's price/credit/refund_pct/basis parameters, a full history reconciliation across 15 class_fitness_events rows on packQ (13 bookings + 2 in-window cancellations), a second history read for the just-logged no-show fee, and a genuine cross-category read of Marcus's active Enterprise Partner corporate wellness enrollment (CPARAM employer_discount_pct=25, capped by the tier's own corporate_wellness_discount_pct=8, so the cap binds). Removing either external prerequisite changes something real (archive_2: the workflow's own entry ceiling never clears and it cannot be run at all; no_show_fee_2: refund_amount_usd recomputes to a different, higher figure -- see PREREQUISITE CARD below), and the corp CPARAM factor is load-bearing.
BASE-INVARIANT CARD. class_pack_refund_policy governs class_pack_refunded/class_pack_cancelled: refund_requires_active_pack (state, allowed=[active,closed]) -- packQ is 'active' at open, and this workflow's own step 2 (member confirmation) transitions it to 'closed' before step 3's refund, so the gate is satisfied by the workflow's own internal step, not an external prerequisite this time; refund_within_window (time, anchor=opened_date 2026-09-05, +refund_window_days=10 -> boundary 2026-09-15, not_after, inclusive) -- satisfied at frozen_time 2026-09-12. class_agg_multi_holding (eligibility: [], policy_scope), together with class_ext_pack_refund_2's own declared overwrite extending that ceiling check to refund-finalization time (base_policy_refs now includes class_agg_multi_holding), is the source of this workflow's own external state_gate prerequisite: packQ (active), packS (exhausted), packT (active) and packU (active) sit at 4 open packs at frozen_time, genuinely exceeding the 2-pack ceiling. The gate is tested immediately before the refund is recorded, i.e. after step 4 has already closed packQ for its own, unrelated reason -- at that checkpoint the remaining count (packS+packT+packU=3) is still over the ceiling, so this SOP may not finalize its refund until the one surplus pack that is itself exhausted or expired -- packS -- is also archived, bringing the checkpoint count to 2. class_cancellation_window_policy and class_habitual_no_show_suspension (both eligibility: []) carry policy_scope for the no-show log itself. class_pack_expiration_policy's only structured gate (expiration_window_elapsed) applies_to=[class_pack_lapsed] only, not class_pack_archived, so packS's archival carries policy_scope from that reference alone.
BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. Target object of the workflow: class_pass_holdings row packQ (20-Class Pack). Correlation key: class_pass_id=packQ on every class_fitness_events row the refund's SUM reads. All 15 pre-existing rows carry class_pass_id=packQ or packS and customer_id=cust as appropriate, so packQ's own rows are unambiguously separable from packS's. sessQ.11 and sessQ.12's in-window cancellations, created by the workflow's own steps 0 and 1, are each linked to their own booking by class_session_id, proving those specific credits are genuinely back in the pool before the refund sums them. packS (the archive target) has no shared session ids with packQ, so archiving it cannot be confused with any of packQ's own history.
PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Root: class_wf_pack_closeout_refund (the whole workflow is the problem the member's surface request points at). External prerequisite 1 (state_gate): class_ext_pack_archive_2. gate=class_agg_multi_holding.max_per_customer. condition/policy_source verbatim (from class_ext_pack_refund_2's own rule, which this workflow's step 3 computes): 'A member's overall class-pack portfolio must be brought within the two-pack administrative ceiling that class_agg_multi_holding sets before this pack's own refund can be finalized; any pack still open beyond that ceiling is archived first.' Seed evidence FALSE at open: initial_state.class_pass_holdings.<packQ>.status=active AND initial_state.class_pass_holdings.<packS>.status=exhausted AND initial_state.class_pass_holdings.<packT>.status=active -- three non-closed packs already open for this customer, genuinely exceeding the class_agg_multi_holding cap of 2, before any workflow write lands. packT is active (not archivable), so packS is the unique surplus pack. resolved_by: archive_class_pack_bd5a6a26. External prerequisite 2 (value_input): class_ext_no_show_fee_2. gate=refund_after_noshow (a compute binding of class_ext_pack_refund_2, exercised at workflow step 3). condition/policy_source verbatim: 'Where this pack's history already carries a no_show_fee_usd charge that has not yet been offset elsewhere, that amount is subtracted once from the refund figure before it is finalized, with the subtraction never carrying the result past zero.' Seed evidence FALSE at open: initial_state.class_fitness_events has a class_booked row (evQ.13) for class_session_id=sessQ.13 dated 2026-09-11 (before frozen_time 2026-09-12) with no class_no_show or cancellation row anywhere in initial_state carrying that same class_session_id. resolved_by: log_class_no_show_ec16ff8d. Topological order: {class_ext_pack_archive_2, class_ext_no_show_fee_2} both precede class_wf_pack_closeout_refund's own steps; the two are mutually independent (archive_2 touches only packS's status, no_show_fee_2 touches only packQ's own history) so either order between them leaves every scored parameter identical -- confirmed by running the verification script both ways. Edge deletion sensitivity: skipping archive_2 and replaying the workflow's other declared steps unchanged (0, 2, 3, 4, 5 in order): by the time step 5 (the refund) is reached, step 4 has already closed packQ for its own, unrelated reason, but with archive_2 skipped packS remains exhausted/non-closed, so the checkpoint tested immediately before the refund reads packS+packT+packU=3, still over the 2-pack ceiling -- the entry condition never clears (state_gate; audited structurally; class_ext_pack_refund_2.compute never reads pack count or packS/packT/packU's own fields, so refund_amount_usd itself is unaffected either way, exactly as Principle H permits for a state_gate edge). With archive_2 kept, the same checkpoint reads packT+packU=2, satisfying the ceiling -- a genuine, replay-verifiable difference, because four packs (not three) were open at frozen_time, so step 4's single closure alone is never enough; skipping the no-show log changes refund_amount_usd (see WORKLOG below for the exact before/after figures). user_scenario mentions the old pack only as an unnamed, mechanism-free aside ('an old empty pack ... tidy up') and never names class_ext_pack_archive_2, class_agg_multi_holding, the 3-pack ceiling, 'no-show', or session sessQ.13 -- Marcus's only line touching the no-show is reactive, spoken strictly after the agent raises it. He does, by contrast, explicitly name the two classes to cancel (a yoga class on the 13th and a cycling class on the 14th) -- this is ordinary service content he volunteers as part of his own root request, not a hidden prerequisite, and it is exactly this statement that gives evQ.11/evQ.12 a unique, customer-sourced discriminator distinct from the ceiling/no-show prerequisites he never mentions. Both external-prerequisite tools (see task_tools.py) write unconditionally on their given arguments with no read of the other prerequisite's state and no Error branch.
WORKFLOW ZERO-WAIT CAUSAL CARD. Step 0 (cancel sessQ.11): source_kind=initial_state_preexisting -- the booking row and its class_session_id are already an authoritative record in initial_state; cancelling now with sufficient notice is a synchronous administrative act. Step 1 (cancel sessQ.12): same, initial_state_preexisting, a second independent booking row. Step 2 (member confirms cancellation): source_kind=current_user_input -- Marcus's own real-time confirmation, obtainable immediately once the agent has explained the reconciled position. Step 3 (record refund): source_kind=prior_synchronous_tool_effect -- consumes the real DB deltas of steps 0, 1 and 2 (two new class_fitness_events rows and packQ's status now closed), all of which landed synchronously earlier in this same conversation; no diagnosis, delivery, payment clearing, external review or passage of real time is anywhere in this chain.
WORKLOG / VERIFICATION. no_show_fee_usd = round(15.00*(1-min(25,8)/100),2) = 13.80 (P=15.00 flat fee for 20-Class Pack, corp employer_discount_pct=25 capped by the tier's own corporate_wellness_discount_pct=8 -> 8% actually applied). reference_credit_value_usd (archive_2, on packS, 5-Class Pack) = round((75.00/5)*(1-5/100),2) = 14.25 (packS's own cap is 5, lower than the 20-Class Pack's 8, and lower than the employer's 25, so 5% applies here). refund_amount_usd (packQ, at workflow step 3): hist_credits_delta over all 15 rows on packQ (the 13 bookings evQ.1..evQ.13 plus, once steps 0/1 land, the two new in-window-cancellation rows) = -13+2=-11; reconciled_remaining = 20-11 = 9; basis=credits_used (20-Class Pack) -> value_credits_used = 9/20*240.00 = 108.00; refund_base = 108.00*85/100 = 91.80; outstanding_no_shows (after log_class_no_show_ec16ff8d has landed) = 13.80; refund_after_noshow = max(0, 91.80-13.80) = 78.00 (well clear of the floor); corp_bonus = 78.00*8/100 = 6.24; result = round(78.00+6.24, 2) = 84.24. credits_removed (a non-calculated, directly-reconciled fixed-format argument of the same tool) = reconciled_remaining = 9. Skip-the-no-show recompute: outstanding_no_shows=0 -> refund_after_noshow=91.80 -> corp_bonus=7.344 -> result=99.14, confirming the value_input edge is load-bearing. Swap-the-two-external-prerequisites recompute (no-show logged after archive instead of before): identical final figures. Draft recomputation from the visible context alone (KB prose + tool schemas + Marcus's lines + query returns): a rep would (1) locate and verify Marcus, (2) pull both his class packs and packQ's full booking history, (3) notice packS is exhausted and, per class_agg_multi_holding's 2-pack ceiling together with the workflow's own entry rule, archive it before proceeding, reading off its own corp-capped reference value, (4) notice sessQ.13's class date has passed with no cancellation/no-show row and log it, reading off the corp-discounted fee from the same enrollment, (5) cancel the two other still-outstanding bookings (sessQ.11, sessQ.12) with the credit refunded to the pool, (6) have Marcus confirm the pack's closure, and (7) reconcile the full credit history, apply refund_pct, deduct the no-show fee, add the corp loyalty bonus, and quote 84.24 -- this agrees with gold exactly.
REVISION 2 (policy-task audit fixes). A policy-task audit correctly flagged three defects, all fixed in this pass without changing any scored dollar figure: (1) the class_agg_multi_holding ceiling prerequisite was not genuinely unmet (2 open packs is AT, not OVER, a ceiling of 2) and was undeclared (class_agg_multi_holding was absent from class_ext_pack_refund_2.base_policy_refs/overwrite) -- fixed by adding a third open pack (packT, active) so the customer genuinely holds 3 open packs at the opening, over the ceiling, and by declaring class_agg_multi_holding in base_policy_refs with an explicit overwrite entry extending its 2-pack check to refund-finalization time. (2) The no-show session (evQ.13/sessQ.13) was not uniquely entailed -- ten other bookings (evQ.1..evQ.10) shared its exact shape (past-dated, no settling row). Fixed by re-dating evQ.1..evQ.10 to 2026-09-15..2026-09-24, all after frozen_time, so they are categorically not yet due for any attendance determination; evQ.13 is now the sole past-dated, unsettled row. (3) The two in-window-cancellation targets (evQ.11, evQ.12) were neither uniquely entailed nor temporally sound (their own request_binding text claimed 'still ahead of frozen_time' while their seeded event_timestamp was in the past). Fixed by re-dating evQ.11 to 2026-09-13T10:00 and evQ.12 to 2026-09-14T10:00 (both genuinely ahead of frozen_time by more than cancellation_window_hours=8) and by having Marcus himself name the two classes by date and class type in user_scenario ('a yoga class on the 13th and a cycling class on the 14th') -- this is ordinary root-request content, not a revealed prerequisite, and it uniquely picks out evQ.11/evQ.12 against every other booking on packQ by the (date, class_type) pair. None of these three fixes changes hist_credits_delta, reconciled_remaining, no_show_fee_usd, reference_credit_value_usd or refund_amount_usd (all date-independent SUMs), so the WORKLOG figures above (84.24 / 13.80 / 14.25 / credits_removed=9) stand unchanged.
REVISION 3 (policy-task re-audit fix). A round-2 re-audit found the surviving half of Finding F-T1-1: GT's edge_load_bearing claimed skipping the archive leaves the portfolio 'at 3 open packs,' anchoring the ceiling check to 'the moment of the refund' (workflow step 5). But step 4 (member confirms cancellation) closes packQ itself, for an entirely unrelated reason (refund_requires_active_pack), before step 5 runs -- so by the time the refund step is reached, the non-closed count is only packS+packT=2 whether or not packS was ever archived, falsifying the claim as originally worded. Fixed by re-anchoring the ceiling check to the OPENING of the call (before any of this workflow's own steps run) rather than to the moment of the refund -- a state_gate prerequisite is naturally an opening-moment fact per Principle H ('a prerequisite must genuinely fail to hold at frozen_time'), not a running total re-evaluated after each workflow step. Propagated the same wording fix through class_ext_pack_refund_2.rule, its overwrite[1] of class_agg_multi_holding, the prerequisite[0] condition/policy_source/effect on that same policy, this task's prerequisite_closure.edges[0]/edge_load_bearing[0], and gold_actions[step=10].request_binding. Under the opening-moment anchor, the load-bearing claim is now true and replay-verifiable: the opening world (initial_state) is fixed regardless of which later steps are skipped or kept, so skipping the archive leaves that opening-moment count at 3 (over the ceiling) no matter what step 4 later does to packQ. No scored dollar figure changed (refund_amount_usd=84.24, no_show_fee_usd=13.80, reference_credit_value_usd=14.25, credits_removed=9 all stand); this is a pure re-anchoring of a state_gate's own textual justification, not a change to any compute binding, seed row, or GT argument.
REVISION 4 (policy-task re-audit fix). Round 3's fix introduced a genuine self-contradiction: it defined the ceiling check as an opening-moment fact 'never re-evaluated against any later, in-call change,' while its own `effect` field claimed the later archive step is what makes that fixed value satisfy the ceiling -- an opening-moment value cannot, by the round-3 wording's own definition, be changed by a later action. Root cause of why every prior anchoring attempt failed: with only 3 open packs and step 4 independently closing the target pack, there is no single anchor point where the archive step is both (a) able to change the checked value and (b) not already rendered moot by step 4's own closure. Fixed by changing the WORLD instead of the wording (Route A): added a FOURTH open pack (packU, active, 10-Class Pack, untouched) to initial_state, so the customer holds 4 non-closed packs at frozen_time (packQ, packS, packT, packU), not 3. The ceiling check is now honestly anchored at refund-time (step 5, after step 4 has already closed packQ) with no contradiction: step 4's closure alone drops the count from 4 to 3 (packS+packT+packU), which is STILL over the 2-pack ceiling, so the archive of packS (the only exhausted/expired pack among the four) is what is genuinely, additionally required to bring it to 2. Replay-verified: skipping the archive and keeping steps 0,2,3,4,5 leaves the pre-refund count at 3 (over ceiling); keeping the archive brings it to 2 (satisfied) -- a real, checkable difference caused solely by the archive step, with no self-contradiction, since the checked value is genuinely re-evaluated at refund-time and genuinely depends on which steps ran. Propagated through class_ext_pack_refund_2.rule, its overwrite[1] of class_agg_multi_holding, prerequisite[0] (condition/policy_source/effect), the workflow's order_rationale, this task's initial_state (packU added), prerequisite_closure.edges[0]/edge_load_bearing[0], gold_actions[step=10], the evaluation_criteria archive-call tracing, and seed_consistency for packS/packT/packU. No scored dollar figure changed (refund_amount_usd=84.24, no_show_fee_usd=13.80, reference_credit_value_usd=14.25, credits_removed=9 all stand, since packU is never read by class_ext_pack_refund_2.compute -- auto-scoped SUMs only ever touch the target holding, packQ); this is a world-and-wording fix to the ceiling state_gate's own load-bearing mechanism, not a change to any compute binding or GT argument.
REVISION 6 (render-layer audit fix, applied for corpus consistency). A render-layer audit found task 0's policy_pack_refund_eligibility_basis doc named only the member-confirmed-cancellation route to a refund-eligible closed pack (KB-RUNTIME RED for task 0's exhausted-pack world; task 1's own runtime half PASSED since packQ starts active, so the ambiguity never arises here). For corpus consistency -- class_ext_pack_refund_2 shares the same base_policy_refs=[class_pack_refund_policy, class_agg_multi_holding] and the same rendered eligibility document as class_ext_pack_refund -- the identical disclosure fix was applied here too: a new overwrite entry (superseded_clause='or in the same moment as its confirmed cancellation to closed', replaced_by a sentence disclosing that administrative archival of an exhausted/expired pack to closed satisfies the identical gate as a member-confirmed cancellation) was added to class_ext_pack_refund_2 and its rule text, so the shared doc states one consistent truth regardless of which task's world a reader is reasoning about. This does not add, remove, or reorder any of this task's own prerequisite edges (the ceiling/no-show edges are untouched) and changes no compute binding, seed row, tool, or GT argument: refund_amount_usd remains 84.24, no_show_fee_usd remains 13.80, reference_credit_value_usd remains 14.25, credits_removed remains 9. initial_state, user_scenario and frozen_time are all unchanged for this task.
user_scenario: Marcus Webb calls sounding a bit apologetic, saying he let his gym schedule slip over the last month and wants to sort out his class packs before it gets any more tangled. He explains he's holding a 20-Class Pack that he doesn't plan to use much longer -- work travel picked up -- and he'd like it cancelled and refunded for whatever's left on it. Before that happens, though, he asks the rep to cancel two classes he still has on the books that he now knows he can't make -- a yoga class on the 13th and a cycling class on the 14th -- since he'd rather have those credits back than let them go to waste once the pack closes. He mentions, almost in passing, that he thinks there's an older, smaller pack on his account too that he emptied out ages ago and never got around to formally closing, and he's fine with the rep tidying that up as well if it helps move things along; he doesn't know or care about the mechanics of why, he just wants the bigger pack closed out and paid back. When asked how to verify him, he gives his email, marcus.webb@example.com, and, if pressed for a second detail, his date of birth, November 3, 1990 (1990-11-03). If asked which pack he wants refunded, he says the 20-Class Pack, the one he's still actively using. If asked whether he wants this handled right now on the phone, he says yes, that's exactly why he called, and he's ready to confirm anything on his end that needs his own say-so. He does not bring up any specific missed class or booking by name -- if the agent tells him that one of his booked classes from earlier in the week was never checked in and so counts as a no-show with its usual fee, he says something like 'ah, that was the one I meant to cancel and forgot -- that's fine, go ahead and charge it, just get me squared away.' He never names a number of his own for any fee or refund and never argues with whatever figure the agent comes back with -- he only reacts to what he's told. Once the agent tells him the pack is closed out and states the final refund figure, he says that sounds right and that he's ready to confirm it himself; when the agent hands him the confirmation and asks him to go ahead, he does so immediately. He thanks the rep afterward and says that wraps up everything he needed.
